Sealed bids will be received at the offices of First Security Bank, National Association, the Financial Advisor to the District, at its address indicated below. The Bonds will be dated April 1, 1997, issuable in fully registered, book-entry only form, in denominations of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof, not exceeding the amount of each maturity. The Bonds will mature serially on June 1 of each of the years and in the principal amounts as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

Interest will be payable commencing December 1, 1997, and semiannually thereafter on June 1 and December 1 in each year, at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7.00%) per annum to be fixed at the time the Bonds are sold. Copies of the OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE, the OFFICIAL STATEMENT, bid forms and other related information with respect to the Bonds, being offered subject to the approval as to legality of Chapman and Cutler, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor to the District, First Security Bank, National Association, 41 East 100 South, Third Floor, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, telephone: (801) 246-5598, FAX: (801) 246-5973.
